description: This Java class is a Spring Boot REST controller managing 'Answer' entities, providing endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting answers associated with questions in a PostgreSQL database.

classes.name: AnswerController
classes.description: A REST controller that handles HTTP requests related to managing answers for questions, including CRUD operations.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all answers for a specific questionId.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new answer to a specific question.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing answer by answerId for a specific question.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an answer by answerId associated with a specific question.
